workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 低光螢光成像的 SNR 預算練習：假設曝光 5 ms，每像素收到 50 個光子。背照式 sCMOS（QE 0.95、讀出雜訊 1.0 e⁻、暗電流 0.7 e⁻/px/s）：訊號 S = 47.5 e⁻，暗電荷 0.7×0.005 = 0.0035 e⁻ 可忽略，SNR = 47.5/√(47.5 + 0.0035 + 1.0²) = 47.5/6.96 = 6.8。前照式感測器（QE 0.60、讀出雜訊 1.6 e⁻）：S = 30 e⁻，SNR = 30/√(30 + 2.56) = 30/5.71 = 5.3。若實驗要求 SNR ≥ 20，背照式需要平均 (20/6.8)² ≈ 8.6，即 9 張；前照式需要 (20/5.3)² ≈ 14.2，即 15 張。再檢查快門：2304 列、列時間 10 µs 的偏斜為 23 ms，大於 5 ms 的曝光，所以不存在所有列同時曝光的窗口，脈衝照明必須改用全域重置模式或連續照明。數值為教學假設，不代表任何特定相機的規格。
workedExample.textEn: SNR-budget exercise for low-light fluorescence: assume a 5 ms exposure with 50 photons per pixel. A back-illuminated sCMOS with QE 0.95, read noise 1.0 electron and dark current 0.7 electron per pixel per second gives S = 47.5 electrons, a negligible dark charge of 0.7×0.005 = 0.0035 electron, and SNR = 47.5/√(47.5 + 0.0035 + 1.0²) = 47.5/6.96 = 6.8. A front-illuminated sensor with QE 0.60 and read noise 1.6 electrons gives S = 30 electrons and SNR = 30/√(30 + 2.56) = 30/5.71 = 5.3. If the experiment needs SNR ≥ 20, the back-illuminated camera must average (20/6.8)² ≈ 8.6, so 9 frames, while the front-illuminated one needs (20/5.3)² ≈ 14.2, so 15 frames. Then check the shutter: 2304 rows at a 10 µs line time give a skew of 23 ms, longer than the 5 ms exposure, so no window exists in which all rows are exposed together and pulsed illumination must switch to a global-reset mode or continuous light. Values are teaching assumptions, not the specification of any particular camera.

workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

steps.title: 光子到電子：量子效率與像素結構：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Photons to electrons: quantum efficiency and pixel structure: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「背照式像素與釘扎光電二極體」如何決定科學級 CMOS 成像系統的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Back-illuminated pixel and pinned photodiode” determines the key performance of “Scientific CMOS imaging systems”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 科學級 CMOS（sCMOS）的每個像素都是一個釘扎光電二極體加上四到五個電晶體：轉移閘把累積的電子送到浮動擴散節點，重置電晶體清空節點，源極隨耦器把電荷轉成電壓，列選擇電晶體把訊號送上行匯流排。量子效率 QE 是入射光子被轉成可收集電子的比例；前照式像素的金屬連線與多晶矽閘會遮擋並反射光，即使加微透鏡也只有約 60% 到 80%，背照式把晶圓薄化、從背面入光，峰值 QE 可到 95%。6.5 µm 的像素尺寸是取樣解析度與全井容量之間的折衷。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「背照式像素與釘扎光電二極體」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Every pixel of a scientific CMOS sensor is a pinned photodiode with four or five transistors: a transfer gate moves the collected electrons to a floating-diffusion node, a reset transistor empties the node, a source follower converts charge to voltage, and a row-select transistor puts the signal on the column bus. Quantum efficiency is the fraction of incident photons converted to collectable electrons; in a front-illuminated pixel the metal wiring and polysilicon gates shade and reflect light, so even with microlenses QE stays near 60 to 80 percent, whereas back-illumination thins the wafer and admits light from the rear, pushing peak QE to about 95 percent. The 6.5 µm pixel pitch is a compromise between sampling resolution and full-well capacity. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Back-illuminated pixel and pinned photodiode”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：轉換增益 CG = q/C_FD。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Conversion gain is CG = q/C_FD.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要像素越小，科學相機的靈敏度就越高。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Smaller pixels always make a scientific camera more sensitive." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「背照式像素與釘扎光電二極體」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Back-illuminated pixel and pinned photodiode”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 光子到電子：量子效率與像素結構：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Photons to electrons: quantum efficiency and pixel structure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「背照式像素與釘扎光電二極體」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Back-illuminated pixel and pinned photodiode” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：轉換增益 CG = q/C_FD。取浮動擴散電容 C_FD = 1.6 fF，CG = 1.602×10⁻¹⁹ C / 1.6×10⁻¹⁵ F = 100 µV/e⁻；全井 15,000 e⁻ 對應約 1.5 V 的節點電壓擺幅。若 100 個光子落在像素上，背照式（QE 0.95）得到 95 e⁻，前照式（QE 0.60）只有 60 e⁻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Conversion gain is CG = q/C_FD. With a floating-diffusion capacitance C_FD = 1.6 fF, CG = 1.602×10⁻¹⁹ C / 1.6×10⁻¹⁵ F = 100 µV per electron, so a full well of 15,000 electrons corresponds to about 1.5 V of node swing. If 100 photons land on a pixel, a back-illuminated sensor with QE 0.95 yields 95 electrons while a front-illuminated one with QE 0.60 yields only 60. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用已校正的單色光源照射感測器，以 NIST 溯源的參考光電二極體量入射光子通量，把每像素平均電子數除以光子數得到各波長的 QE 曲線；再與廠商的光譜響應曲線比較，重點核對 400 nm 以下與 800 nm 以上兩端，因為背面鈍化與矽厚度的差異在這兩端最明顯。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Illuminate the sensor with a calibrated monochromatic source and measure the incident photon flux with a reference photodiode traceable to NIST; divide the mean electrons per pixel by the photon count at each wavelength to obtain the QE curve, then compare with the vendor spectral response, paying particular attention to the regions below 400 nm and above 800 nm where backside passivation and silicon thickness differ most.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 光子到電子：量子效率與像素結構：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Photons to electrons: quantum efficiency and pixel structure: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「背照式像素與釘扎光電二極體」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Back-illuminated pixel and pinned photodiode” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用已校正的單色光源照射感測器，以 NIST 溯源的參考光電二極體量入射光子通量，把每像素平均電子數除以光子數得到各波長的 QE 曲線；再與廠商的光譜響應曲線比較，重點核對 400 nm 以下與 800 nm 以上兩端，因為背面鈍化與矽厚度的差異在這兩端最明顯。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Illuminate the sensor with a calibrated monochromatic source and measure the incident photon flux with a reference photodiode traceable to NIST; divide the mean electrons per pixel by the photon count at each wavelength to obtain the QE curve, then compare with the vendor spectral response, paying particular attention to the regions below 400 nm and above 800 nm where backside passivation and silicon thickness differ most. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：背面鈍化不良時，表面態會俘獲短波長產生的電子，藍光與紫外 QE 大幅下降，且隨溫度與照射歷史漂移；影像看起來正常，但定量螢光比值會隨時間偏移。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Poor backside passivation lets surface states trap the electrons generated by short wavelengths, so blue and ultraviolet QE collapses and drifts with temperature and illumination history; images look normal but quantitative fluorescence ratios shift over time.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。

steps.instruction: sCMOS 的行級讀出電路一次只能處理一列，滾動快門因此讓每一列依序重置、曝光、讀出：每列曝光時間相同，但起始時刻相差一個列時間 t_line，整個畫面的首列與末列相差 N_rows×t_line。移動物體會被剪切變形，脈衝照明會在畫面上留下亮暗條帶。全域快門讓所有像素同時開始與結束曝光，但需要在像素內增加一個儲存節點與遮光結構，讀出雜訊通常高於滾動模式（例如 2.3 e⁻ 對 0.9 e⁻），填充因子也較低。許多 sCMOS 提供全域重置或光片讀出模式，用時序而非像素結構解決同時性問題。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「滾動快門時序圖」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Column readout circuits handle one row at a time, so a rolling shutter resets, exposes and reads rows in sequence: every row gets the same exposure, but its start is delayed by one line time t_line, and the first and last rows differ by N_rows×t_line. Moving objects shear and pulsed illumination leaves bright and dark bands across the frame. A global shutter starts and stops exposure for all pixels at once but needs an in-pixel storage node and light shield, so read noise is usually higher than in rolling mode (for example 2.3 versus 0.9 electrons) and the fill factor is lower. Many sCMOS cameras offer a global-reset or light-sheet readout mode that solves simultaneity with timing rather than pixel structure. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Rolling-shutter timing diagram”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 滾動快門與全域快門的曝光幾何：定量估算

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rolling-shutter timing diagram” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：畫面偏斜 = N_rows×t_line。取 2048 列、t_line = 10 µs，偏斜 = 20.48 ms。若曝光 t_exp = 30 ms，所有列同時開啟的窗口 = t_exp − 偏斜 = 9.52 ms，脈衝照明必須落在這 9.52 ms 內才不會產生條帶；若 t_exp 只有 5 ms，則不存在同時窗口，必須改用全域快門或全域重置。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Frame skew = N_rows×t_line. For 2048 rows and t_line = 10 µs the skew is 20.48 ms. With an exposure t_exp = 30 ms the window in which every row is open at once is t_exp − skew = 9.52 ms, so a light pulse must fall inside those 9.52 ms to avoid banding; with t_exp = 5 ms no common window exists and a global shutter or global-reset mode is required. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用一顆 LED 以 100 µs 的脈衝在曝光期間不同時刻閃爍，記錄哪些列被照亮，從亮帶的列數反推 t_line 與偏斜；再把閃爍時刻掃過整個曝光，確認同時開啟窗口的長度與計算值一致，並對照相機輸出的曝光結束觸發訊號。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Flash an LED for 100 µs at different moments during the exposure and record which rows are illuminated; from the number of bright rows deduce t_line and the skew, then sweep the flash across the whole exposure to confirm that the length of the common open window matches the calculation and lines up with the camera's exposure-end trigger output.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。

steps.title: 讀出鏈：相關雙取樣與雙增益 ADC：原理與系統邊界

steps.objective: 說明「源極隨耦器與行級 ADC」如何決定科學級 CMOS 成像系統的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Source follower and column ADC” determines the key performance of “Scientific CMOS imaging systems”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 每一行都有自己的放大器與類比數位轉換器，數千個 ADC 平行工作，才能在低於 2 e⁻ 的讀出雜訊下達到每秒數十張全幅影像。重置浮動擴散節點時，開關的熱雜訊會在電容上留下隨機的 kTC 電荷，相關雙取樣先取樣重置電位、再取樣轉移後電位並相減，把這項雜訊消掉。剩下的讀出雜訊主要來自源極隨耦器的 1/f 與隨機電報雜訊，因此讀得越慢、取樣頻寬越窄，雜訊越低：同一顆相機在超靜音模式可達 0.7 e⁻，在快速模式約 1.6 e⁻。雙增益 ADC 同時以高增益與低增益數位化，再合成 16 位元輸出，兼顧低光靈敏度與全井動態範圍。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「源極隨耦器與行級 ADC」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Each column has its own amplifier and analog-to-digital converter, and thousands of ADCs work in parallel, which is how full frames can be read at tens of frames per second with read noise below 2 electrons. Resetting the floating-diffusion node leaves a random kTC charge from switch thermal noise on the capacitance; correlated double sampling samples the reset level, then the post-transfer level, and subtracts them, cancelling that term. The remaining read noise comes mainly from 1/f and random-telegraph noise in the source follower, so slower readout with narrower sampling bandwidth gives lower noise: the same camera reaches 0.7 electrons in ultra-quiet mode and about 1.6 electrons in fast mode. Dual-gain ADCs digitize each pixel at high and low gain simultaneously and merge the results into a 16-bit output, preserving both low-light sensitivity and full-well dynamic range. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Source follower and column ADC”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 讀出鏈：相關雙取樣與雙增益 ADC：定量估算

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Source follower and column ADC” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：重置雜訊 σ_kTC = √(kTC)/q。取 T = 300 K、C_FD = 1.6 fF：kTC = 1.38×10⁻²³×300×1.6×10⁻¹⁵ = 6.62×10⁻³⁶ C²，開根號得 2.57×10⁻¹⁸ C，除以 1.602×10⁻¹⁹ C 約為 16 e⁻ rms。沒有相關雙取樣時這 16 e⁻ 會主宰讀出雜訊；有 CDS 後殘餘雜訊降到約 1 e⁻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Reset noise is σ_kTC = √(kTC)/q. Without correlated double sampling those 16 electrons would dominate the read noise; with CDS the residual falls to about 1 electron. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在完全遮光、最短曝光下連續拍 100 張，逐像素計算時間標準差並除以增益得到每像素的讀出雜訊分布；報告中位數與均方根兩個值，並分別在快速、標準與超靜音模式重複，確認雜訊隨讀出速度的趨勢與資料表一致，同時檢查直方圖尾端是否有隨機電報雜訊造成的高雜訊像素。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Capture 100 frames in complete darkness at the shortest exposure, compute the temporal standard deviation of each pixel and divide by the gain to obtain the per-pixel read-noise distribution; report both the median and the rms, repeat in fast, standard and ultra-quiet modes to confirm that noise falls with readout speed as the datasheet states, and inspect the histogram tail for high-noise pixels caused by random-telegraph noise.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 背照式製程、矽厚度與冷卻封裝：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Back-illuminated process, silicon thickness and cooled packaging: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「薄化晶圓與抗反射膜」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Thinned wafer and anti-reflection coating” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：厚度 d 的矽層吸收比例為 1 − exp(−α·d)。取 d = 10 µm：700 nm 時 α ≈ 1.9×10³ cm⁻¹，α·d = 1.9，exp(−1.9) = 0.15，吸收比例 0.85；900 nm 時 α ≈ 306 cm⁻¹，α·d ≈ 0.31，exp(−0.31) = 0.73，吸收比例只有 0.27。這解釋了為何同一顆背照式感測器 700 nm 的 QE 可達 80% 以上，而 900 nm 掉到 30% 以下。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A silicon layer of thickness d absorbs the fraction 1 − exp(−α·d). With d = 10 µm: at 700 nm α ≈ 1.9×10³ cm⁻¹, α·d = 1.9, exp(−1.9) = 0.15 and 0.85 of the light is absorbed; at 900 nm α ≈ 306 cm⁻¹, α·d ≈ 0.31, exp(−0.31) = 0.73 and only 0.27 is absorbed. This is why the same back-illuminated sensor can exceed 80 percent QE at 700 nm yet fall below 30 percent at 900 nm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以 850 nm 與 900 nm 的窄頻光源量 QE，與可見光 QE 比較，檢查近紅外衰減是否符合由矽厚度推算的吸收比例；再用針孔投影的點光源量測相鄰像素的訊號分攤比例（串擾），確認厚度的選擇在 QE 與串擾之間取得的平衡符合規格。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure QE with narrow-band sources at 850 nm and 900 nm and compare with the visible QE to check that the near-infrared roll-off matches the absorbed fraction predicted from the silicon thickness; then project a pinhole point source and measure how much signal spills into neighbouring pixels (crosstalk) to confirm that the chosen thickness balances QE and crosstalk as specified.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 光子轉移法：增益、讀出雜訊與全井容量：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Photon-transfer method: gain, read noise and full-well capacity: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「光子轉移曲線」如何決定科學級 CMOS 成像系統的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Photon-transfer curve” determines the key performance of “Scientific CMOS imaging systems”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 光子轉移法利用散粒雜訊的統計性質校正整條讀出鏈：電子數的變異數等於其平均值，所以在以數位單位（DN）量到的平均值與變異數之間，斜率就是增益 K（DN/e⁻）。做法是在均勻照明下對每個曝光時間拍兩張，取差影像的變異數除以 2 消除固定圖樣雜訊，對平均值作圖；零光點的截距給讀出雜訊，曲線在全井附近轉折並下降。這正是 EMVA 1288 標準規定的量測核心，所得的增益把後續所有雜訊都換算到電子單位。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「光子轉移曲線」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The photon-transfer method calibrates the whole readout chain from the statistics of shot noise: the variance of the electron count equals its mean, so the slope of variance against mean, both measured in digital numbers, is the gain K in DN per electron. Under uniform illumination two frames are taken at each exposure time, the variance of their difference is halved to remove fixed-pattern noise, and it is plotted against the mean; the intercept at zero light gives the read noise and the curve bends over and falls near full well. This is the core measurement prescribed by the EMVA 1288 standard, and the resulting gain converts every later noise figure into electrons. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Photon-transfer curve”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：σ²_DN = K·μ_DN + σ²_read,DN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: σ²_DN = K·μ_DN + σ²_read,DN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「感測器的增益可以直接從位元深度算出，不需要量測。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A sensor's gain can be derived from its bit depth without measurement." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「光子轉移曲線」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Photon-transfer curve”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 光子轉移法：增益、讀出雜訊與全井容量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Photon-transfer method: gain, read noise and full-well capacity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「光子轉移曲線」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Photon-transfer curve” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：σ²_DN = K·μ_DN + σ²_read,DN。若平均值從 500 DN 增到 2500 DN 時變異數從 230 DN² 增到 1150 DN²，K = 920/2000 = 0.46 DN/e⁻，即每 DN 約 2.17 e⁻；暗幀變異數 0.30 DN² 的截距給 σ_read = 0.55 DN = 0.55/0.46 ≈ 1.2 e⁻。全井 15,000 e⁻ 對應 6,900 DN。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: σ²_DN = K·μ_DN + σ²_read,DN. If the variance rises from 230 DN² to 1150 DN² while the mean rises from 500 DN to 2500 DN, then K = 920/2000 = 0.46 DN per electron, about 2.17 electrons per DN; the dark-frame variance intercept of 0.30 DN² gives σ_read = 0.55 DN = 0.55/0.46 ≈ 1.2 electrons, and a full well of 15,000 electrons corresponds to 6,900 DN. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用積分球或擴散板提供均勻度優於 1% 的照明，曝光時間以等比級數從暗到飽和取 20 個以上的點，每點兩張；在線性區以最小平方法擬合斜率與截距，把得到的讀出雜訊與前一單元的暗幀時間雜訊比較，並確認飽和轉折點換算的全井與資料表的 15,000 e⁻ 差異在 10% 以內。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Provide illumination uniform to better than 1 percent with an integrating sphere or diffuser, step the exposure geometrically from dark to saturation in at least 20 points with two frames each, fit slope and intercept by least squares in the linear region, compare the derived read noise with the dark-frame temporal noise from the previous unit, and check that the full well implied by the saturation knee agrees with the datasheet value of 15,000 electrons to within 10 percent.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: σ²_DN = K·μ_DN + σ²_read,DN。若平均值從 500 DN 增到 2500 DN 時變異數從 230 DN² 增到 1150 DN²，K = 920/2000 = 0.46 DN/e⁻，即每 DN 約 2.17 e⁻；暗幀變異數 0.30 DN² 的截距給 σ_read = 0.55 DN = 0.55/0.46 ≈ 1.2 e⁻。全井 15,000 e⁻ 對應 6,900 DN。
knowledge.textEn: σ²_DN = K·μ_DN + σ²_read,DN. If the variance rises from 230 DN² to 1150 DN² while the mean rises from 500 DN to 2500 DN, then K = 920/2000 = 0.46 DN per electron, about 2.17 electrons per DN; the dark-frame variance intercept of 0.30 DN² gives σ_read = 0.55 DN = 0.55/0.46 ≈ 1.2 electrons, and a full well of 15,000 electrons corresponds to 6,900 DN.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

options: σ²_DN = K·μ_DN + σ²_read,DN。

steps.title: 光子轉移法：增益、讀出雜訊與全井容量：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Photon-transfer method: gain, read noise and full-well capacity: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「光子轉移曲線」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Photon-transfer curve” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用積分球或擴散板提供均勻度優於 1% 的照明，曝光時間以等比級數從暗到飽和取 20 個以上的點，每點兩張；在線性區以最小平方法擬合斜率與截距，把得到的讀出雜訊與前一單元的暗幀時間雜訊比較，並確認飽和轉折點換算的全井與資料表的 15,000 e⁻ 差異在 10% 以內。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Provide illumination uniform to better than 1 percent with an integrating sphere or diffuser, step the exposure geometrically from dark to saturation in at least 20 points with two frames each, fit slope and intercept by least squares in the linear region, compare the derived read noise with the dark-frame temporal noise from the previous unit, and check that the full well implied by the saturation knee agrees with the datasheet value of 15,000 electrons to within 10 percent. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：照明不均或光源閃爍會使差影像的變異數偏大，擬合出的增益偏高、讀出雜訊偏低，後續以電子為單位的 SNR 模型全部樂觀；症狀是重複量測的增益值離散超過 5%。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Non-uniform or flickering illumination inflates the variance of the difference image, so the fitted gain is too high and the read noise too low, and every later SNR model in electrons becomes optimistic; the symptom is a gain value that scatters by more than 5 percent between repeated runs.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用積分球或擴散板提供均勻度優於 1% 的照明，曝光時間以等比級數從暗到飽和取 20 個以上的點，每點兩張；在線性區以最小平方法擬合斜率與截距，把得到的讀出雜訊與前一單元的暗幀時間雜訊比較，並確認飽和轉折點換算的全井與資料表的 15,000 e⁻ 差異在 10% 以內。
knowledge.textEn: Provide illumination uniform to better than 1 percent with an integrating sphere or diffuser, step the exposure geometrically from dark to saturation in at least 20 points with two frames each, fit slope and intercept by least squares in the linear region, compare the derived read noise with the dark-frame temporal noise from the previous unit, and check that the full well implied by the saturation knee agrees with the datasheet value of 15,000 electrons to within 10 percent.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「光子轉移法：增益、讀出雜訊與全井容量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Photon-transfer method: gain, read noise and full-well capacity"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
用積分球或擴散板提供均勻度優於 1% 的照明，曝光時間以等比級數從暗到飽和取 20 個以上的點，每點兩張。

Read noise is a fixed constant of the sensor, independent of readout speed.
quiz.explanation: 用積分球或擴散板提供均勻度優於 1% 的照明，曝光時間以等比級數從暗到飽和取 20 個以上的點，每點兩張；在線性區以最小平方法擬合斜率與截距，把得到的讀出雜訊與前一單元的暗幀時間雜訊比較，並確認飽和轉折點換算的全井與資料表的 15,000 e⁻ 差異在 10% 以內。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Provide illumination uniform to better than 1 percent with an integrating sphere or diffuser, step the exposure geometrically from dark to saturation in at least 20 points with two frames each, fit slope and intercept by least squares in the linear region, compare the derived read noise with the dark-frame temporal noise from the previous unit, and check that the full well implied by the saturation knee agrees with the datasheet value of 15,000 electrons to within 10 percent. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 光子轉移法：增益、讀出雜訊與全井容量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Photon-transfer method: gain, read noise and full-well capacity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「光子轉移曲線」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Photon-transfer curve” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 照明不均或光源閃爍會使差影像的變異數偏大，擬合出的增益偏高、讀出雜訊偏低，後續以電子為單位的 SNR 模型全部樂觀；症狀是重複量測的增益值離散超過 5%。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Non-uniform or flickering illumination inflates the variance of the difference image, so the fitted gain is too high and the read noise too low, and every later SNR model in electrons becomes optimistic; the symptom is a gain value that scatters by more than 5 percent between repeated runs. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這正是 EMVA 1288 標準規定的量測核心，所得的增益把後續所有雜訊都換算到電子單位。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: This is the core measurement prescribed by the EMVA 1288 standard, and the resulting gain converts every later noise figure into electrons.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「感測器的增益可以直接從位元深度算出，不需要量測。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A sensor's gain can be derived from its bit depth without measurement." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 照明不均或光源閃爍會使差影像的變異數偏大，擬合出的增益偏高、讀出雜訊偏低，後續以電子為單位的 SNR 模型全部樂觀；症狀是重複量測的增益值離散超過 5%。
knowledge.textEn: Non-uniform or flickering illumination inflates the variance of the difference image, so the fitted gain is too high and the read noise too low, and every later SNR model in electrons becomes optimistic; the symptom is a gain value that scatters by more than 5 percent between repeated runs.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。

quiz.question: 在「光子轉移法：增益、讀出雜訊與全井容量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Photon-transfer method: gain, read noise and full-well capacity" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：訊號 S = 10,000 e⁻ 時散粒雜訊 √S = 100 e⁻；若 PRNU = 0.5%，固定圖樣雜訊為 50 e⁻，總雜訊 √(100² + 50²) = 112 e⁻，SNR 從 100 降到 89。用 100 張平場平均後殘餘 PRNU 約 0.05%，即 5 e⁻，SNR 回到 99.9。暗電流 1.0 e⁻/px/s 在 −8 °C、曝光 10 s 時累積 10 e⁻，其散粒雜訊 3.2 e⁻ 已超過 1 e⁻ 的讀出雜訊。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: At a signal S = 10,000 electrons the shot noise √S is 100 electrons; with PRNU = 0.5 percent the fixed-pattern term is 50 electrons, the total is √(100² + 50²) = 112 electrons and the SNR drops from 100 to 89. steps.title: 系統訊噪比、奈奎斯特取樣與光學匹配：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: System SNR, Nyquist sampling and optical matching: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「SNR 模型與取樣匹配表」如何決定科學級 CMOS 成像系統的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “SNR model and sampling-match table” determines the key performance of “Scientific CMOS imaging systems”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 整合相機時要同時滿足兩件事：每個像素收到的電子數要讓 SNR 達標，而像素在樣品面上的等效尺寸要符合奈奎斯特取樣。SNR = S/√(S + D·t + σ_r²)，其中 S = QE·N_ph 是訊號電子數，D 是暗電流，σ_r 是讀出雜訊；低光時讀出雜訊主宰，所以 1 e⁻ 與 6 e⁻ 的差異決定能否看見訊號。取樣方面，物鏡的瑞利解析度 r = 0.61λ/NA，像素投影到樣品面的尺寸 p/M 必須不大於 r/2；放大率太低會欠取樣失去解析度，太高則把有限的光子攤到太多像素而降低每像素 SNR。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「SNR 模型與取樣匹配表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Integrating a camera means satisfying two things at once: each pixel must collect enough electrons for the required SNR, and the pixel's equivalent size at the sample must meet Nyquist sampling. SNR = S/√(S + D·t + σ_r²), where S = QE·N_ph is the signal in electrons, D the dark current and σ_r the read noise; at low light the read noise dominates, so the difference between 1 and 6 electrons decides whether a signal is visible at all. For sampling, the objective's Rayleigh resolution is r = 0.61λ/NA and the pixel projected onto the sample, p/M, must not exceed r/2; too little magnification undersamples and loses resolution, too much spreads the limited photons over too many pixels and lowers per-pixel SNR. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “SNR model and sampling-match table”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Take S = 20 electrons and D·t = 0.1 electron: with σ_r = 1.0 electron, SNR = 20/√(20 + 0.1 + 1) = 4.35; with σ_r = 1.6 it is 4.20; with σ_r = 6 it is 20/√56.1 = 2.67.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「放大率越高，影像解析度一定越好。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Higher magnification always gives better image resolution." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “SNR model and sampling-match table” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：取 S = 20 e⁻、D·t = 0.1 e⁻：σ_r = 1.0 e⁻ 時 SNR = 20/√(20 + 0.1 + 1) = 4.35；σ_r = 1.6 e⁻ 時 4.20；σ_r = 6 e⁻ 時 20/√56.1 = 2.67。取樣：λ = 520 nm、NA = 1.4 的物鏡 r = 0.61×520/1.4 = 227 nm，r/2 = 113 nm；6.5 µm 像素配 60× 時 p/M = 108 nm 剛好符合奈奎斯特，配 100× 則為 65 nm，過取樣 1.7 倍。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Take S = 20 electrons and D·t = 0.1 electron: with σ_r = 1.0 electron, SNR = 20/√(20 + 0.1 + 1) = 4.35; with σ_r = 1.6 it is 4.20; with σ_r = 6 it is 20/√56.1 = 2.67. For sampling, an objective with NA = 1.4 at λ = 520 nm has r = 0.61×520/1.4 = 227 nm and r/2 = 113 nm; a 6.5 µm pixel at 60× gives p/M = 108 nm, just meeting Nyquist, while 100× gives 65 nm, an oversampling of 1.7 times. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：拍一片 USAF 1951 解析度靶或亞解析度螢光珠：由珠子影像的半高全寬反推系統點擴散函數，與 r 比較確認沒有欠取樣；再在已知光子通量下量測影像 SNR，與模型預測值比對，差異超過 20% 時回頭檢查 QE、增益或讀出模式的設定。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Image a USAF 1951 resolution target or sub-resolution fluorescent beads: derive the system point-spread function from the full width at half maximum of the bead images and compare with r to confirm there is no undersampling; then measure the image SNR at a known photon flux and compare with the model prediction, revisiting the QE, gain or readout-mode settings if the discrepancy exceeds 20 percent.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.instruction: 拍一片 USAF 1951 解析度靶或亞解析度螢光珠：由珠子影像的半高全寬反推系統點擴散函數，與 r 比較確認沒有欠取樣；再在已知光子通量下量測影像 SNR，與模型預測值比對，差異超過 20% 時回頭檢查 QE、增益或讀出模式的設定。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.title: 相機驗收、觸發時序與資料鏈路交接：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「驗收紀錄與資料鏈路」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Acceptance record and data link” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：資料率 = 像素數×位元深度×幀率。2304×2304 = 5.31×10⁶ 像素，16 位元每幀 10.6 MB；89.1 fps 時為 946 MB/s ≈ 7.6 Gbit/s，超過 USB 3.0 實際約 350 MB/s 的能力，需要 CoaXPress 或把幀率限制到 31.6 fps（335 MB/s）。一小時連續擷取會產生 3.4 TB 資料。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Data rate = pixel count × bit depth × frame rate. 2304×2304 = 5.31×10⁶ pixels at 16 bits is 10.6 MB per frame; at 89.1 fps that is 946 MB/s, about 7.6 Gbit/s, beyond the roughly 350 MB/s that USB 3.0 delivers in practice, so CoaXPress is needed or the rate must be limited to 31.6 fps (335 MB/s). One hour of continuous capture produces 3.4 TB. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用脈衝產生器同時觸發相機與一台示波器，從相機的曝光輸出訊號量延遲與抖動（典型為微秒級）；以最高幀率連續擷取 10 分鐘，核對影像序號是否連續、時間戳間隔是否等於 1/幀率，並檢查儲存系統的寫入速度餘裕至少 20%。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Trigger the camera and an oscilloscope from the same pulse generator and measure delay and jitter on the camera's exposure output, typically microseconds; capture continuously at the maximum frame rate for 10 minutes, check that frame numbers are consecutive and timestamp intervals equal 1/frame rate, and verify that the storage system keeps at least 20 percent write-speed margin.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.
